shot.continuity: one continuous take, camera moves every beat; the paper is the only wipe

subject.character: red deer stag, joyful gait, deadpan eyes; after the wipe, a mounted trophy head — only eyes and mouth move, neck fixed to a plaque
subject.secondary_character: woodpecker on the door frame, red cap; insert 6.8-7.4s, a third of frame, hammers a paper
subject.background_character: fox on the rug; insert 3.8-4.3s, a third of frame: glances slyly, snatches a paper, folds an airplane

props.notice: stamped paper from the forest, pinned to the plaque
props.woodpecker_notice: second stamped paper, at the frame
props.papers: folder of stamped papers on the desk, spills open; fox takes one
props.fortochka: small vent pane, ajar, in the window

setting: sunlit office, tall windows, daylight, dark wood panelling

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130 Hz, dry, unrushed deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: seven lines, three groups, no gap inside a group, unrushed
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves each syllable, his own voice, never voice over

timeline.a: silent. Deer bursts from birches, joyful gallop, tail up, dust kicking
silent. Mid-leap, a paper drops, slaps his face, whites the lens
timeline.cam: hard track, push through the paper

timeline.a: silent. Wipe clears: forest gone, now a mounted trophy head over the desk, eyes open
mouth moves, eyes steady, unrushed; papers drifting below
same delivery; light slides across antlers, a paper drifts off the desk
silent. Camera swings onto the fox: glances slyly, snatches a paper, folds an airplane
silent. Swings back onto the head; a paper riffles past below, light flaring off the antlers
same delivery, eyes narrow; a paper riffles off the desk, light sweeps antlers
same delivery, eyes narrowed; light sweeps the plaque, catching the stamp
silent. Woodpecker lands, grips a paper, hammers it to the frame, chips fly
camera on the face, mouth moves; woodpecker drums at the edge, final strike lands, stops
timeline.cam: pulls back onto the face, woodpecker at the edge

timeline.a: office quiet; last chips drift past the eye, gaze locked
silent. Frame holds the plaque, all three papers stirring in the draft, woodpecker and fox
timeline.cam: push reveals everyone and every paper

timeline.a: silent. Eyes slide to his paper on the plaque
silent. Light flares on the antlers; fox flings the airplane through the vent

negative_prompt: night, dusk, evening light, candle, neon, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene, underexposed, haze, fog, mist; floating or duplicate props, a fourth paper; second stag, second woodpecker or second fox; human hand; a torso below the mounted head; fox touching the head; missing or blurred insert; subtitles, captions, watermark, lettering beyond the stamp; English speech, foreign accent, slow or drawn-out delivery, gaps between lines; extra cuts besides the wipe, locked-off camera, snap zoom; extra limbs, horizontal framing
